knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic wealth and market snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional clients, assets, returns, benchmarks, life events, planning signals, market values, and dates support deterministic demos.

knowledge.name: Wealth controls and review rules
knowledge.detail: Packaged guidance separates evidence, calculations, preparation, advice, suitability decisions, specialist review, and external actions.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Five skills define routing, procedures, synthetic evidence, safety statements, and review checkpoints.

intelligence_processing.name: Fixed market snapshot briefing
intelligence_processing.detail: Presents packaged index, yield, and practice-AUM context with synthetic and non-current labels instead of live market claims.

intelligence_processing.name: Unified client wealth analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines managed and held-away assets, performance, risk profiles, review dates, and life events into an advisor-ready client view.

intelligence_processing.name: Planning-signal prioritization
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks fixed education, liquidity, estate, RMD, and reallocation signals for review without giving advice or contacting clients.

intelligence_processing.name: Performance attribution context
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic returns with fixed strategy benchmarks and labels alpha and attribution without forecasts or suitability findings.

intelligence_processing.name: Advisor meeting preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts household facts and prompts while requiring advisor and client validation of facts, suitability, consent, and disclosures.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access for advisors, relationship managers, directors, and strategists in a validated Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs WealthInsightsGeneratorAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with deterministic synthetic-only routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Advisor and client review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents evidence-first briefs for licensed-advisor validation and client confirmation before any recommendation or external use.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic market and practice brief
management_reporting.detail: Reports fixed market values, returns, yields, observations, and total practice AUM while clearly denying current-data status.

management_reporting.name: Client wealth and opportunity overview
management_reporting.detail: Shows managed and held-away assets, alpha, relationship health, review dates, life events, and prioritized planning signals.

management_reporting.name: Performance attribution report
management_reporting.detail: Lists strategy benchmarks, client returns, benchmark returns, alpha, attribution labels, and AUM-weighted alpha for review.

management_reporting.name: Draft advisor meeting brief
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes household assets, risk profile, next review, facts to validate, and discussion prompts without advice or outreach.

tools.name: Portable WealthInsightsGeneratorAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements five read-only operations over bundled synthetic wealth and market evidence.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft package, two synthetic knowledge files, and five skills; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 wealth-management CRM
tools.detail: Approved future seam for relationship context; it is not connected to the current fixed synthetic package.

tools.name: Approved portfolio aggregation
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seam for managed and held-away asset evidence; no live account aggregation is configured.

tools.name: Financial planning and performance systems
tools.detail: Approved future seam for planning and performance evidence; current calculations use only bundled fictional records.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: Approved preparation seam for reviewed materials; the agent does not send outreach, schedule meetings, or contact clients.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams specialist review
tools.detail: Approved collaboration seam for human review; the package sends no messages, requests no approvals, and executes no actions.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional records and forbids browsing, freshness claims, enrichment, substitution, or invention of missing facts.

supporting_features.name: Five deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes market brief, client insights, opportunity alerts, performance attribution, and meeting brief requests to explicit handlers.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed identifier handling
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown client IDs instead of substituting another household or fabricating wealth, planning, or performance evidence.

supporting_features.name: Regulated decision-support boundary
supporting_features.detail: Provides no investment, tax, legal, estate, retirement, or financial advice, suitability findings, or performance promises.

supporting_features.name: Advisor and client review gate
supporting_features.detail: Requires licensed-advisor validation and client confirmation, plus compliance, tax, legal, estate, or trading review as applicable.

supporting_features.name: No transaction execution or side effects
supporting_features.detail: Prevents outreach, CRM changes, live aggregation, opportunity creation, orders, transactions, approvals, and record updates.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Five persona cases verify deterministic evidence and safety boundaries; Copilot Studio artifacts remain Draft until separately approved.
